_comment: Input manifest for update_vendor.py. Edit this to add a package or bump a pin, then run the
script; it resolves 'auto' to the newest release whose Requires-Python still admits our floor,
writes vendor.lock.json with the exact versions and hashes it used, and prints the spec lines.
pygments is deliberately absent. Rich reaches it only through rich/syntax.py, which the
'neuter_rich_syntax' patch replaces with a plain-text shim, so nothing imports pygments and it
need not be vendored at all. The script asserts that afterwards.
'license' is the authoritative SPDX id for the spec's License tag. The script cross-checks it
against each wheel's own metadata and fails on a mismatch, so a relicense upstream cannot slip

inject.note: Our own MIT null-highlighter shim, not the real Pygments. See patches/pygments/__init__.py.

drift_ignore.pygments: Declared by rich and textual, but deliberately satisfied by the injected shim above rather than vendored. The smoke test proves the shim covers what they import.
